_about: Client words about Kinetic, collected from Slack and Gmail by the Kinetic Assistant hub (Nov 17 2026). None were written as testimonials. A quote renders on the site only when approved is true, and approval means Hunter has the client's OK on the exact words and the attribution (name, role, company, logo). Builds with PUBLIC_DRAFT_QUOTES=1 (the preview only) also show unapproved ones, marked as drafts; the production build never sets it. The hub tracks asking and approval on the board (clients/<slug>.testimonial). confidential: true means the client is confidential and must never be shown, even in a draft preview, without their explicit OK.
